issues.description: Farm.singFarmSong() is specified and stubbed to return void and print the song, but the solution implements it as `public String singFarmSong()` returning the full song text. This creates an incompatible method contract between problem statement/template and solution, and will break student code depending on which contract they follow (printing vs. returning).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the contract across all artifacts. Either change the solution to `public void singFarmSong()` and print the verses directly, or update the problem statement and template to require `public String singFarmSong()` and adjust any example usage accordingly.

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse is specified in the UML/problem statement as `singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal)` but the template stub omits the Animal parameter (commented out), while the solution defines `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`. This forces students to infer and edit the signature beyond the provided starter code and may cause confusion about the intended helper method contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template stub to include the parameter: `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (or `private String ...` if adopting the solution’s return-string design) and ensure the problem statement/template consistently describe the chosen approach.
